mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pull_task_standard_group_setting ( task_id, setting_timing, group_name, is_material_filename_as_group_name, avatar_file_key, group_description, is_auto_unmute_after_task, is_auto_close_invite_after_task, edit_permission_mode, mute_mode, link_permission_mode, disappearing_message_mode, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{settingTiming}, #{groupName}, #{materialFilenameAsGroupName}, #{avatarFileKey}, #{groupDescription}, #{autoUnmuteAfterTask}, #{autoCloseInviteAfterTask}, #{editPermissionMode}, #{muteMode}, #{linkPermissionMode}, #{disappearingMessageMode}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pull_task_standard_group_setting s INNER JOIN pull_task t ON t.id = s.task_id AND t.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.avatar_file_key = #{avatarFileKey} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT s.tenant_id AS tenantId, s.task_id AS taskId, s.avatar_file_key AS avatarFileKey FROM pull_task_standard_group_setting s INNER JOIN pull_task t ON t.id = s.task_id AND t.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.avatar_file_key IS NOT NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.id IN #{taskId}
